gorp.name: T01 Pass Through
gorp.comment:
The smallest design that is still complete. One model carries a single dimensionless number in, one algorithm copies it, one model carries it out.
Every variable is measured (\one) and says how repeat observations merge (Monotone), which is everything the no-fail rule asks for. Nothing else is here on purpose: if this one does not check clean, the problem is in the checker rather than in the design.
gorp.expect:
Check finds nothing — 0 errors, 0 warnings — so Run is available.
Run posts the design to xmlIT and comes back with status OK. That proves the transport and nothing more: xmlIT is a deliberate placeholder that reads the body and discards it, so no computed value comes back for any design on this shelf.
